apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Keys for the bisibility API, each with a scope and an expiry.
apiKeys.emptyDescription: The first key is made with Create key.
apiKeys.createDescription: Name the key and choose its access and expiry policy.
apiKeys.newDescription: The full secret is available one time.

scope.readDescription: Read rankings, keywords and project metadata.
scope.writeDescription: Read and update keywords, checks, tags and exports.
scope.adminDescription: Full project API access, including admin operations.

apiKeys.adminWarning: Full access can perform admin operations for this project.

expiry.neverWarning: This key never expires and must be rolled or revoked manually.

apiKeys.oldRevoked: The old key was revoked and now returns 401.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.rollWarningTitle: The old key stops working immediately and returns 401.
apiKeys.rollWarningDescription: Integrations using it will fail until you replace the secret with the new key.
apiKeys.revealWarning: Copy your key now - it will not be shown again.
apiKeys.revealStorage: bisibility stores only a hash and display prefix after this window closes.
apiKeys.storeSecret: Store this secret in a secret manager before closing this window.

errors.createUnavailable: API key creation is unavailable for this project.
errors.create: API key could not be created.
errors.roll: API key could not be rolled.
errors.revoke: API key could not be revoked.

apiKeys.spendTooltip: Counts against the API, MCP and SDK budget

webhooks.title: Deploy webhooks
webhooks.inbound: Inbound: your CI calls bisibility after a deploy and the call becomes a timeline signal.
webhooks.outbound: The outbound webhook is the alert channel on Notifications, not this.
webhooks.disabledDescription: Disabled: the row and the token stay.
webhooks.sendTestDescription: Send test posts a real signal and links to it.
webhooks.emptyDescription: Add a hook to turn deploy events into timeline signals.
webhooks.newDescription: The token is available one time.
webhooks.rotatedDescription: The old token stopped working. Copy the replacement now.
webhooks.revealWarning: Copy this token now - it will not be shown again.
webhooks.revealStorage: bisibility stores only a hash after this window closes.
webhooks.urlHelp: Use this URL only when the provider cannot send custom headers - query strings can end up in proxy and access logs. Netlify deploy notifications need this form. Append the provider as an extra query parameter, for example &provider=netlify (or ?provider=vercel / ?provider=amplify when the token is sent as a header instead).
webhooks.tokenHelp: Prefer this token as an Authorization: Bearer header. AWS Amplify EventBridge API destinations support that header.
webhooks.curlHelp: Replace the masked token placeholder with the one-time token above, then run the command.
webhooks.deleteDescription: Delete {label}? Sources using this token will start failing immediately. This cannot be undone.
